scene: The spun spindle clicks, unlocking three departures across the echoing vault.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a neon cavern floor. On the far left stands a metal service elevator with open mesh gates. Left of centre stands the boy in his denim jacket and camera, facing forward. In the centre, a wooden rowing boat bobs at a canal dock. On the far right waits a yellow night tram.
